title: Existence of K-flat resolutions on a ringed site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. For every cochain complex $\mathcal G^\bullet$ of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules there exist a K-flat complex $\mathcal K^\bullet$ [def-pc-kflat-complex] whose terms are flat $\mathcal O$-modules and a quasi-isomorphism $\mathcal K^\bullet\to\mathcal G^\bullet$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] which is surjective in every degree.

mathlib_searches.results: none: no K-flat notion, and no resolution statement for sheaves of modules
`IsKProjective` only, with no existence theorem for sheaves of modules (sheaves of modules have no enough projectives in general)
